newsitem.title: USA: Vikonics says renegotiating debt terms.
newsitem.headline: Vikonics says renegotiating debt terms.

text.p: Vikonics Inc said Friday it is attempting to renegotiate payment terms of $570,000 of debt that fell due on June 30, 1996.
It said it had no ability to pay the obligations, which are owed to private investors, former directors and its legal counsel ex-director.
The company said there can be no assurance that it will be successful in its efforts to renegotiate the payment terms.
It said that as of December 31, it had $22,000 cash on hand, a working capital deficit of $1.4 million and a shareholders' deficit of $1.4 million.
Vikonics makes and markets computer-based security systems.
